fact: At its 35th board meeting on 2 June 2023 OMPIC reported the pilot launch in February 2023 of the electronic company creation platform at the Rabat court for professionals, and the launch of the beneficial ownership register (RBE).
title: 35ème Conseil d'administration de l'OMPIC 2 Juin 2023
publisher: Office Marocain de la Propriété Industrielle et Commerciale
